title: ISSP-NL 2009 & 2012: Family and Social Inequality
contributors: Funding Agency: Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research - NWO
descriptions: The modules 2009 (“Social Inequality IV”) and 2012 (“Family and Gender Roles IV”) of the International Social Survey Programme in the Netherlands [ISSP-NL] were conducted in March-September 2013 as a stand-alone postal survey at VU University Amsterdam [VUA] (Faculty of Social Sciences, Department of Sociology) by Harry B.G. Ganzeboom [principal investigator] and Shashi Roopram [fieldwork manager]. Note that the complete dataset is more elaborate than the Dutch part of the international ISSP file, archived at GESIS - Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences, Cologne, Germany.
